title: Gargoti Delight
description: This mode add Algerian food most selled in small restaurants.
body:
**Gargoti** this is the word called for local restaurant in Algiers They usually specialize in simple, traditional fast food. You’ll find things like garantita (chickpea flan), loubia (bean stew), douara, or basic sandwiches.
## What in this mod ?
**Menu:**
- fries and omelet sandwich
- fries 🍟 
- and more 

**Items and blocks:**
- Oil sangou !!!
- fryer 
- Harissa
- and more...
remember it is in **early development**
